description: This file defines the main activity class for an Android app controlling a missile launcher via USB and sensor input. It manages USB device connection, sends control commands, and responds to accelerometer tilt movements to control the launcher.

classes.name: MissileLauncherActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling USB device communication, accelerometer sensor events, and UI interactions for the missile launcher.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI buttons, and obtains system services for USB management and sensors.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listener when activity pauses.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listener and handles USB device attachment/detachment events.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Establishes connection with the USB device, claims interface, and starts the background thread for handling interrupt requests.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends control commands to the USB device via control transfer.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click to trigger the fire command.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Background thread method that polls device status and handles firing stop if needed.
